provenance.corpus: hand-authored synthetic HTML parsed through public baseline and current rules
provenance.historicDom: project-database pages rows have no inline HTML; retained content_hash values can resolve shared HTML, but linkage to the frozen September 17 selected sites/reports was not established and no historic replay was used
provenance.sourceSafety: example.invalid URLs only; no crawl bodies, credentials, or private reports

multiPageObserved.note: one 12-page group; renders as a fix-once line

observed.text: Fix once in the site footer (footer > a:1): link text "read more" is generic, 12 pages: /s0, /s1, /s10 (+9 more)

repeatedSubtree.text: Likely one shared block in the site footer (footer > a:1): link text "read more" is generic, seen on 12 pages: /s0, /s1, /s10 (+9 more)

singlePageGroups.note: every group covers 1 page; must be byte-identical to legacy

runtime.method: Independent baseline/current parser and rule runs after warmups; same-machine observations only.
caveats: Heap deltas are process-local snapshots and include allocator/GC effects; they are not retained-memory measurements.
Raw report-view bytes include legacy grouping plus component fix groups and are not JSON wire payload measurements.

Synthetic DOMs do not establish performance or grouping outcomes for the historic Product Hunt crawl; retained project hashes can resolve shared HTML, but linkage to the frozen reports used here is unestablished.

evidenceBytes.note: Ladder rungs are hoisted into a shared table; only the per-element locators repeat.

ruleRuntime.method: 1,000 generic links in one block inside <main>, alternating min-of-9 against the pre-feature commit; a single back-to-back pair is not reliable at this size.
ruleRuntime.note: Measured after the region signature became a streaming digest, which removed more cost than the ladder added. An earlier ladder-only build measured about +18%.

subtreePromotionCost.accepted: Runtime and evidence size were reviewed and accepted for the value of turning per-page findings into one repair target.

limitations: Public local selected-rule/report paths only; cloud/dashboard consumers remain unverified.
Unknown, main-content, and article-nested observations remain raw evidence without a cross-page actionable target.
The expected memberships are an authored corpus oracle, not labels recovered from historic reports.
A repeated-subtree group is promoted on structure and page count, not on knowing the pages share a template; its attribution says so.
